messages.content: [2026 FIFA World Cup Group D] Group D of the 2026 FIFA World Cup took place from June 12 to 25, 2026. The group consisted of the United States (co-host), Paraguay, Australia, and Turkey. This also marked the return of Turkey and Paraguay to the World Cup finals, their first appearances since 2002 and 2010 respectively. The United States were the second team to secure their place in the round of 32 after Mexico, and were guaranteed to top the group after two consecutive wins. Australia finished in second place, edging out Paraguay based on head-to-head goal difference. Paraguay's performance allowed them to advance as one of the eight best third-place teams, and would further advance into the round of 16 (all other third-place teams were eliminated by then). Turkey exited the tournament after two consecutive defeats but managed to beat co-hosts the United States in their final group match. | other articles: 2026 FIFA World Cup Group B, 2022 FIFA World Cup knockout stage
